epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local environment provisioning time from >1 hour to <5 minutes
epics.tocConstraintRef: Developer onboarding and local testing bottleneck
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml at the repository root to start the full stack
R2: Expose a health-check endpoint for system observability

slices.title: System Containerization and Health Check
slices.jtbd: When implementing containerization for this epic, I want to add a docker-compose.yml and a health-check, so that the full stack can be started and verified locally.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a repository without a containerized deployment manifest,
When a developer runs docker-compose up,
Then the full stack initializes successfully.
Given the running stack,
When integration and E2E checks run against the health-check endpoint,
Then it responds with a success status, completing full test pyramid coverage.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase health-check availability from 0% to 100% for running containers

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce time to update or delete materials from >10 mins to <1 min
requirements: R1: Support updating existing epidemiological materials via UI
R2: Support deleting existing epidemiological materials via UI

slices.title: Material Update and Deletion UI Patch
slices.jtbd: When implementing material management for this epic, I want to patch the existing UI to support update and delete actions, so that the catalog can be maintained accurately.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the catalog,
When a user edits it via the UI and saves,
Then the frontend invokes the PUT API and the catalog updates.
Given an existing material in the catalog,
When automated unit, integration, and E2E tests execute the update and delete workflows,
Then all assertions pass and the actions succeed end-to-end natively.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce frontend PUT and DELETE API integration errors from unknown to 0

epics.title: System Authentication and Authorization
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized access incidents from unknown to 0 per month
requirements: R1: Block unauthenticated access to the catalog and material creation
R2: Prompt unauthenticated users to log in using the existing session mechanism

slices.title: Authentication Integration Patch
slices.jtbd: When implementing access control for this epic, I want to patch the existing code to enforce authentication, so that restricted epidemiological protocols are protected.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user,
When they attempt to access the catalog,
Then they are blocked and prompted to log in.
Given an unauthenticated user,
When unit, integration, and E2E tests attempt unauthorized material creation,
Then the actions are denied, satisfying full QA pyramid natively.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Missing route guards and API session validation
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase protected route authentication coverage from 0% to 100%
